azizi-venice-new.title: Azizi Venice
azizi-venice-new.description: Azizi Venice in Dubai South by Azizi Developments offers waterfront studios and 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments plus villas from AED 630,000, with a 40/60 payment plan and 2026 handover.
azizi-venice-new.long_description: Azizi Venice is a waterfront residential development in Dubai South by Azizi Developments, offering luxurious studios, 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments and villas within a vibrant community of water-based living, set around natural lagoons and verdant landscapes. Choose from studios (350–420 sq. ft.), 1-bedroom apartments (650–850 sq. ft.), 2-bedroom apartments (900–1,200 sq. ft.) and 3-bedroom apartments (1,400–1,700 sq. ft.). Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and an on-site health care centre. Priced from AED 630,000 on a 40/60 payment plan with handover in 2026.

the-heights-by-emaar.title: The Heights By Emaar
the-heights-by-emaar.description: The Heights by Emaar targets families and investors looking for space, privacy, and long-term value. Thoughtfully designed 3 & 4-bedroom townhouses and 4-bedroom villas with generous layouts, set within a signature Emaar community close to Al Maktoum International Airport, District 2020 and Dubai Investment Park.
the-heights-by-emaar.long_description:
The Heights by Emaar is a premium townhouse and villa community designed for families and investors seeking space, privacy and long-term value. Residences feature thoughtfully designed layouts that prioritise comfort and everyday living, within a master-planned Emaar community.

Unit options and indicative pricing:
- 3-Bedroom Townhouses — 2,167 sqft — from AED 2.49M
- 4-Bedroom Townhouses — 2,881 sqft — from AED 3.46M
- 4-Bedroom Villas — 3,680 sqft — from AED 4.78M

Connectivity: 10 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport, 10 minutes to District 2020, 10 minutes to Dubai Investment Park, and around 30 minutes to Downtown Dubai.
highlights: 10 min to Al Maktoum International Airport

mercedes-benz-places-new.title: Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City (Project Maybach)
mercedes-benz-places-new.description: Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City (Project Maybach) offers 816 units — 608 studios, 76 one-bed, 92 two-bed and 40 three-bed apartments plus 15 retail shops — across 51 residential floors with 4.2m ceilings, from AED 808,000.
mercedes-benz-places-new.long_description: A new urban community emerges, shaped by the principles of elegance and purity. Defined by precision engineering and a rational, functional grid, Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City (Project Maybach) introduces an architectural language where every form is intentional and every proportion considered — a city conceived with clarity, where design discipline gives rise to timeless expression. The 51-storey landmark rises on an 8,763.69 sq. m. (94,332 sq. ft.) plot with 4.2 m ceilings, delivering 816 units in total: 608 studios, 76 one-bedroom, 92 two-bedroom and 40 three-bedroom apartments, alongside 15 ground-floor retail shops. Residents enjoy solar photovoltaic technology, a skyline jogging path, smart systems, private pool, podium pool, spa service, gymnasium and valet service. Priced from AED 808,000.

tilal-binghatti.title: Tilal Binghatti
tilal-binghatti.description: Binghatti's first villa and townhouse community — low-rise, low-density freehold homes on Dubai Al Ain Road with smart-home features, private pools and a curated retail spine. 18 minutes to Downtown Dubai.
tilal-binghatti.long_description: Tilal Binghatti at Al Rowaiyah is Binghatti's inaugural villa and townhouse community, marking a shift from the developer's Business Bay tower silhouette to a low-rise, low-density freehold neighbourhood along the Dubai Al Ain Road. Residences span 3-bedroom townhouses (2,200-2,500 sqft), 4-bedroom townhouses (2,700-3,100 sqft) and 5-bedroom villas, each with private pool, built-in wardrobes and smart-home systems. The masterplan is anchored by Golden Beach, a shopping mall, fitness centre, kids play area, community centre, restaurants, jogging track and barbecue zones — with 18-minute connectivity to Burj Khalifa / Downtown Dubai and 7 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall. Payment: 10% down, 40% during construction, 50% on handover. Freehold ownership open to all nationalities. Kangar coordinates the full purchase: unit shortlist, developer negotiation, mortgage pre-approval for non-residents and DLD registration.
highlights: 18 min to Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa

binghatti-pinnacle.title: Binghatti Pinnacle
binghatti-pinnacle.description: Binghatti Pinnacle — a contemporary 2 & 3-bedroom residential tower in Al Jadaf, moments from the upcoming metro extension and minutes to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and DXB Airport. Handover imminent.
binghatti-pinnacle.long_description: Binghatti Pinnacle sits at the heart of Al Jadaf, one of Dubai's fastest-emerging districts, with direct access to the upcoming metro extension and rail spine. The tower delivers efficient 2 & 3-bedroom apartments — 2-beds from 1,050 to 1,303 sqft and 3-beds from 1,490 to 1,702 sqft — with contemporary layouts and Binghatti's signature textured facade. Residents get a full amenity stack: swimming pool, gymnasium, yoga platform, kids play areas, residents' lounge, ground-floor retail and landscaped gardens. Positioning is a rare mix — a near-Downtown location at a mid-market entry point, with connectivity to Business Bay, Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport in under 10 minutes. Kangar coordinates the full purchase end to end: unit selection, developer negotiation, mortgage pre-approval for non-residents and DLD registration.
highlights: Al Jadaf — near new metro station

samana-imperial-gardens.title: Samana Imperial Gardens
samana-imperial-gardens.description: Samana Imperial Gardens in Arjan by Samana Developers offers studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments from AED 800,000, with a 20% down payment and Q4 2028 handover.
samana-imperial-gardens.long_description: Blooming in the heart of Arjan, Samana Imperial Gardens by Samana Developers stands as a celebration of garden living at its finest, with thoughtful design and natural aesthetics for residents seeking elevated lifestyle experiences. Choose from studios (~40 m² / ~430 sq. ft.) up to 1 and 2-bedroom apartments (~66.8 m² / ~720 sq. ft.), with 1–3 bathrooms. Residents enjoy an adult swimming pool, children's pool, shallow pools and water beds, pool deck, sunken seating and BBQ zones. Priced from AED 800,000 with a 20% down payment and handover in December 2028 (Q4 2028).

binghatti-starlight.title: Binghatti Starlight
binghatti-starlight.location: Al Jaddaf, Healthcare City Phase 2, Dubai, UAE
binghatti-starlight.description: Binghatti Starlight is a 25-storey waterfront tower in Al Jaddaf (Healthcare City Phase 2) with 510 studios from AED 775,000, on a 100% payment plan and March 2026 handover.
binghatti-starlight.long_description: Binghatti Starlight is a 25-storey waterfront residential tower by Binghatti in Al Jaddaf, Healthcare City Phase 2, featuring open floor layouts, spacious interiors and superior finishes. The structure includes 3 basement parking levels, ground floor, mezzanine, 2 podium levels and 20 residential floors on a plot of 4,116.78 sq. m. (44,313 sq. ft.), delivering 510 studios in total (65 units available as of November 2025). Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 775,000 on a 100% payment plan with handover in March 2026.

binghatti-hillcrest.title: Binghatti Hillcrest
binghatti-hillcrest.location: Arjan, Al Barsha South 3, Dubai, UAE
binghatti-hillcrest.description: Binghatti Hillcrest in Arjan (Al Barsha South 3) is a 5-storey development of 69 studios and 74 one-bed apartments from AED 750,000, on a 100% payment plan and December 2026 handover.
binghatti-hillcrest.long_description: Discover elevated living at Binghatti Hillcrest, a striking five-storey residential development by Binghatti Developers in Arjan, Al Barsha South 3. The development blends contemporary design with premium finishes and offers convenient access to major Dubai landmarks while maintaining a tranquil setting. The community comprises 69 studios and 74 one-bedroom apartments. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and a spa and sauna. Priced from AED 750,000 on a 100% payment plan with handover in December 2026.

binghatti-hillside.title: Binghatti Hillside
binghatti-hillside.location: Dubai Science Park (Umm Suqeim Road), Dubai, UAE
binghatti-hillside.description: Binghatti Hillside is a ~189-unit mid-rise near Dubai Science Park with layered terraces and open-plan studios from AED 750,000, on a 100% payment plan — 12 min to Dubai Marina.
binghatti-hillside.long_description: Binghatti Hillside is a contemporary mid-rise development by Binghatti Developers along Umm Suqeim Road near Dubai Science Park, featuring layered terraces and geometric accents for a distinctive urban edge, with open-plan studio layouts. The podium includes landscaped gardens, swimming pool, gym, walking track, dining outlets and children's play areas, emphasising green communal spaces. The community spans approximately 189 units, priced from AED 750,000 on a 100% payment plan. Just 12 minutes to Dubai Marina and 8 minutes to Al Barsha and Mall of the Emirates.

new-commercial-tower-shahrukhz-by-danube.title: Shahrukhz By Danube – New Commercial Tower
new-commercial-tower-shahrukhz-by-danube.description: Shahrukhz by Danube is the first iconic 55-storey commercial tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, offering Standard to Prestige shell-and-core offices from AED 2,000,000 on a 6-year 70/30 payment plan (2–3 min walk to metro).
new-commercial-tower-shahrukhz-by-danube.long_description: Step into Shahrukhz By Danube, a new landmark featuring 55 floors of shell-and-core offices, offering the best panoramic city views. As the first iconic commercial tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, this is a place where professional excellence is not just in the design but also in the sweeping city vistas that greet you every day, just 2–3 minutes walk from the metro. Office layouts range from Standard (500–600 sq. ft.) and Executive (800–1,200 sq. ft.) to Premium (1,500–1,800 sq. ft.) and Prestige (2,500–11,000 sq. ft.). Starting from AED 2,000,000 on a 6-year plan — 70% during construction and 30% post-handover over 2.5 years — with a 1% payment plan option and priority given to clients with 14% payment. AED 50,000 minimum booking to secure your future office.

binghatti-haven.title: Binghatti Haven
binghatti-haven.description: Binghatti Haven in Dubai Sports City is a 26-storey tower offering studios and 1, 2 & 3-bed apartments from AED 1,450,000, with a 100% payment plan and Q1 2026 handover.
binghatti-haven.long_description: Binghatti Haven is a 26-storey high-rise residential tower by Binghatti Developers in Dubai Sports City, laid out over basement and ground-level parking, three podium levels and a rooftop level. The development offers studios (from 385.78 sq. ft.), 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom (from AED 1,450,000, with 116 units available) and 3-bedroom apartments, set in green surrounding areas. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, kids play area, BBQ zones and walking track. Priced from AED 1,450,000 on a 100% payment plan with handover in Q1 2026.

binghatti-amberhall.title: Binghatti Amberhall
binghatti-amberhall.description: Binghatti Amberhall in Jumeirah Village Circle offers 115 studios (from AED 650,000) and 113 one-bed apartments (from AED 1,000,000), with a 100% payment plan and February 2026 handover.
binghatti-amberhall.long_description: Binghatti Amberhall by Binghatti Developers is a refined statement of luxury life in Jumeirah Village Circle — stylish homes in a family-friendly destination framed by green areas, parks and modern architecture. The tower delivers 115 studios from AED 650,000 and 113 one-bedroom apartments from AED 1,000,000. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gymnasium, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and 24/7 security. Available on a 100% payment plan with handover in February 2026.

binghatti-hillviews.title: Binghatti Hillviews
binghatti-hillviews.description: Binghatti Hillviews in Dubai Science Park offers studios and 1 & 2-bedroom apartments from AED 800,000, with panoramic Dubai skyline and Dubai Hills views, on a 100% payment plan and Q1 2026 handover.
binghatti-hillviews.long_description: Binghatti Hillviews by Binghatti Developers is a residential landmark in Dubai Science Park offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Dubai skyline, Dubai Hills and surrounding landscapes, with innovative architecture and premium design. Choose from studios (386–494 sq. ft. from AED 800,000), 1-bedroom apartments (803–887 sq. ft.) and 2-bedroom apartments (1,116–1,476 sq. ft.). Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, kids play area, BBQ zones, walking track and jogging track. Available on a 100% payment plan with handover in Q1 2026.

azizi-lina.title: Azizi Lina
azizi-lina.description: Azizi Lina in Jebel Ali offers studios and 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments by Azizi Developments from AED 546,000, in a master-planned family community with health club, forest landscape and jogging tracks.
azizi-lina.long_description: Azizi Lina in Jebel Ali, Dubai is a new residential project by Azizi Developments offering a range of luxury residences — studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments — with the best amenities and features at a very attractive price. The design is both impressive and simple, equipped with high-end fittings and fixtures. Jebel Ali is one of the perfectly master-planned communities in Dubai, with family-friendly settings and a community-oriented atmosphere that makes it a great choice for home buyers and investors. Residents enjoy retail outlets, bicycle and jogging tracks, a children's playground, forest landscape, health club and extra visitor parking. Priced from AED 546,000.

azizi-david.title: Azizi David
azizi-david.description: Azizi David in Al Jaddaf offers studios, 1–2 bedroom apartments and 3–4 bedroom penthouses from AED 764,000, with a state-of-the-art gym, private cinema, pools, saunas, jacuzzis and dedicated kids areas.
azizi-david.long_description: At Azizi David, life balances vitality and leisure in perfect harmony. Start your day in the state-of-the-art gym, retreat to the private cinema, or unwind by the pools while children delight in their dedicated play areas — every detail designed for comfort and enjoyment. Located in Al Jaddaf, Dubai, the development by Azizi Developments delivers studios (326–424 sq. ft.), 1-bedroom apartments (643–862 sq. ft.), 2-bedroom apartments (838–1,365 sq. ft.), 3-bedroom penthouses (2,819 sq. ft.) and 4-bedroom penthouses (3,475 sq. ft.). Residents also enjoy jogging and bicycle tracks, saunas, jacuzzis, steam rooms and BBQ zones. Priced from AED 764,000.

damac-district.title: DAMAC District
damac-district.description: DAMAC District in DAMAC Hills is a 3-tower, ~1,008-unit mixed-use community with 1 & 2-bed apartments and offices from AED 1,142,000, on a 20/40/40 payment plan and direct DAMAC Mall access.
damac-district.long_description: Imagine a district built not just for today, but for the life you aspire. At the heart of DAMAC Hills, DAMAC District blends luxury residences, modern offices and world-class amenities into one landmark destination across three towers with approximately 1,008 units. From serene water retreats and yoga gardens to AI-powered gyms, padel courts, private dining pods, red-light therapy, kids pool and playground, and BBQ stations, every detail is crafted to elevate life. With smart offices, outdoor workspaces and direct access to DAMAC Mall, it is where lifestyles flourish, ambitions thrive and every experience flows seamlessly. Apartments range 740–1,220 sq. ft. and offices 3,164–6,588 sq. ft. Priced from AED 1,142,000 on a 20% down payment, 40% during construction and 40% on handover payment plan.

azizi-riviera.title: Azizi Riviera
azizi-riviera.description: Azizi Riviera in Nad Al Sheba 1 offers studios and 1-bedroom apartments from AED 834,000, with beachside living, outdoor dining, retail outlets and premium concierge services like laundry and car wash.
azizi-riviera.long_description: Azizi Riviera by Azizi Developments in Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, offers a luxurious lifestyle with beachside living, outdoor dining and exclusive retail outlets. Choose from studios (380–493 sq. ft.) and four one-bedroom types (699 sq. ft., 856 sq. ft., 924 sq. ft. and 1,121 sq. ft.), enjoying indoor and outdoor playgrounds for leisure and premium services like on-site laundry and car wash. Residents also enjoy dining outlets and restaurants, a gymnasium, parks and leisure areas — convenience and luxury blend seamlessly to create an exceptional living experience. Starting from AED 834,000.

azizi-wares.title: Azizi Wares
azizi-wares.description: Azizi Wares beside JAFZA in Downtown Jebel Ali is an exclusive freehold community of studios and 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments from AED 555,000, with private cinema, gaming lounge and clubhouse.
azizi-wares.long_description: Azizi Wares, a distinctive address beside JAFZA in Jebel Ali, combines contemporary elegance with unmatched connectivity. This exclusive freehold residence by Azizi Developments features meticulously designed studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments that elevate everyday living. With seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and the metro, Dubai's key destinations are effortlessly within reach. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gymnasium, kids play area, private cinema, gaming lounge and clubhouse. Priced from AED 555,000 (EOI: Studio AED 18,000 · 1BR AED 25,000 · 2BR AED 45,000 · 3BR on request).

sparklz-by-danube.title: Sparklz By Danube
sparklz-by-danube.description: Sparklz by Danube is a 15-storey Al Furjan tower offering flex studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments from AED 876,258, with smart, sustainable interiors and premium lifestyle amenities.
sparklz-by-danube.long_description: Sparklz by Danube is a 15-storey mid-rise tower in Al Furjan featuring elegant and premium homes with stylish looks, soft warm interior themes, ample carpet areas and smart, sustainable features. The development delivers flex studios of 446 sq. ft. from AED 900,000, flex 1 BHK of 860 sq. ft. from AED 1,300,000, 2 BHK of 1,100 sq. ft. from AED 1,850,000 and 3 BHK of 1,385 sq. ft. from AED 2,350,000. Residents enjoy a gym, kids play area, BBQ facilities, walking track, private balconies, on-site café and restaurants, health care centre and 24/7 security. Starting from AED 876,258.

binghatti-skyblade.title: Binghatti Skyblade
binghatti-skyblade.description: Binghatti Skyblade in Downtown Dubai is a landmark tower with studios featuring private jacuzzis, 1BR royal suites with lap pools, and only 10 ultra-exclusive 2BR Burj Royal Suites with private top-floor pools facing Burj Khalifa. From AED 1.67M (USD 456,000).
binghatti-skyblade.long_description: Binghatti Skyblade rises proudly in the vibrant heart of Downtown Dubai — a true architectural masterpiece that redefines luxury living with its sleek, futuristic façade and striking silhouette. This iconic landmark offers an exclusive collection of exquisitely crafted residences, thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes, world-class amenities, and breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline. Residents can choose from premium studios with private jacuzzis (from USD 456,000 / AED 1.67M), 1-bedroom royal suites with private lap pools (from USD 993,500 / AED 3.64M), the ultra-exclusive 2-bedroom Burj Royal Suites limited to only 10 units — each featuring a private pool on the top floors with direct Burj Khalifa views — and the 3-bedroom Burj Royal Wing. Residents enjoy a podium pool, gymnasium, kids play area, health care centre, restaurants and a luxurious spa. Payment plan: 10% booking + 10% down payment + 50% during construction.

danube-bayz102.title: Danube BAYZ102
danube-bayz102.location: D86 Al Mustaqbal St, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
danube-bayz102.description: Danube BAYZ102 in Business Bay offers 334 studios plus 1-bed and 2-bed apartments with 40+ world-class amenities including a skyline infinity pool, golf simulator, bowling and cinema — from AED 1,270,000.
danube-bayz102.long_description: Danube BAYZ102 is a landmark residential tower by Danube Properties on D86 Al Mustaqbal Street in Business Bay, Dubai. The tower delivers 334 studios (363–405 sq. ft.), 1-bedroom apartments (665 sq. ft.), 2-bedroom apartments (1,464 sq. ft.) and flex studios (762 sq. ft.) across a total footprint of around 8,320 sq. ft. Residents enjoy 40+ world-class amenities including a skyline infinity pool, spa, steam, sauna, pet park, business centre, indoor gym, salon, library, golf simulator, bowling centre, cinema lounge, podium pool, tennis court, jogging track, snooker and a roof garden, plus a kids area, BBQ zones, walking track and 24/7 security. Priced from AED 1,270,000.

azizi-venice.title: Azizi Venice
azizi-venice.description: Venice Dubai South introduces a modern waterfront lifestyle inspired by the charm of Venice — 244 residences across 26 furnished floors with a paddle court, outdoor cinema, dining outlets and a curated leisure podium.
azizi-venice.long_description: Azizi Venice reimagines waterfront living in Dubai South, blending Venetian elegance with contemporary Dubai design. The community delivers 244 flats across 26 furnished residential floors and 5 parking levels, with unit sizes from 332 to 2,816 sqft — studios (350–420 sqft), one-beds (650–850 sqft), two-beds (900–1,200 sqft) and three-beds (1,400–1,700 sqft). Residents enjoy a swimming pool, paddle court, kids play area, outdoor covered cinema, dining outlets and sport facilities across the podium. Kangar coordinates the full off-plan purchase: unit shortlist, developer negotiation, mortgage pre-approval for non-residents, and DLD registration.

damac.title: Damac SeaCrest
damac.description: Damac SeaCrest in Dubai Maritime City offers luxury 1, 2 and 3-bedroom waterfront apartments with Arabian Gulf views, starting AED 2,160,000, handover December 2029.
damac.long_description: Damac SeaCrest is a luxury waterfront residential development by DAMAC Properties in Dubai Maritime City, offering 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments with stunning Arabian Gulf views. Homes start at 780 sq. ft. and prices scale from AED 2.16M for 1-beds, AED 3.10M for 2-beds and AED 4.77M for 3-beds. The location combines upscale living within a vibrant mixed-use maritime area with business opportunities and ongoing infrastructure development. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and an on-site nursery. Handover scheduled for December 2029.

one-by-binghatti.title: One By Binghatti
one-by-binghatti.description: Waterfront apartments in Business Bay with breathtaking views of Dubai Water Canal and Burj Khalifa. Contemporary design, private pool options and sustainable technologies throughout.
one-by-binghatti.long_description: One By Binghatti is an upscale Business Bay development positioned on the Dubai Water Canal with sweeping views of the Burj Khalifa. The tower delivers studios and 1–3 bedroom units from 461 to 4,250 sqft, with contemporary interiors, private-pool residence options and eco-conscious building systems. Down payment is 20% with a 70/30 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2026. Kangar coordinates the full off-plan purchase — unit shortlist, developer negotiation, mortgage pre-approval and DLD registration.

binghatti-phantom.title: Binghatti Phantom
binghatti-phantom.description: Binghatti Phantom in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti offers 354 residences — 48 studios, 340 one-bed and 10 two-bed apartments — with 15 retail shops and 5 parking floors, from AED 999,999.
binghatti-phantom.long_description: Binghatti Phantom reflects a non-conformist disposition, challenging conventional norms to create a residential oasis in Jumeirah Village Circle that moves residents beyond ordinary living into innovative possibilities. The tower delivers 354 residential units — 48 studios, 340 one-bedroom and 10 two-bedroom apartments (individual homes around 618 sq. ft.) — across 26 furnished floors, alongside 15 ground-floor retail shops and 5 dedicated parking floors, with a footprint of around 5,776 sq. ft. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ zones. Priced from AED 999,999.

binghatti-phoenix.title: Binghatti Phoenix
binghatti-phoenix.description: Binghatti Phoenix in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti offers 244 residences — 48 studios, 146 one-bed and 50 two-bed apartments across 26 furnished floors, from AED 599,999.
binghatti-phoenix.long_description: Binghatti Phoenix is a residential development by Binghatti in Jumeirah Village Circle, delivering 244 flats across 26 furnished residential floors and 5 dedicated parking levels: 48 studios, 146 one-bedroom and 50 two-bedroom apartments, with typical unit sizes around 618 sq. ft. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and on-site café and restaurants. Priced from AED 599,999.

binghatti-galaxy.title: Binghatti Galaxy
binghatti-galaxy.description: Binghatti Galaxy in Jumeirah Village Circle offers studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments in twin luxury B+G+4+roof towers with 5 parking floors, from AED 599,999 (handover September 2024).
binghatti-galaxy.long_description: Binghatti Galaxy is a twin luxury development in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti Developers, comprising studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments across a B + G + 4 + roof configuration served by 5 dedicated parking floors. Units start from 473 sq. ft. and combine contemporary design with the brand's signature architectural language. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and generous private balconies. Priced from AED 599,999 with 20% down payment, 30% on completion and handover in September 2024.

binghatti-hills.title: Binghatti Hills
binghatti-hills.description: Binghatti Hills in Dubai Science Park is a 1,666-unit residential community — 852 studios, 528 one-bed and 286 two-bed apartments — inspired by rolling hillsides, starting from AED 777,777.
binghatti-hills.long_description: Binghatti Hills is a masterfully designed residential community in Dubai Science Park, capturing the serene ambiance of rolling hillsides through architecture inspired by natural terrain contours. Developed by Binghatti, this large-scale project delivers 1,666 residential units — 852 studios, 528 one-bedroom and 286 two-bedroom apartments — offering respite from the bustle of urban life. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ zones. Priced from AED 777,777.

binghatti-apex.title: Binghatti Apex
binghatti-apex.description: Binghatti Apex is a 33-storey JVC tower by Binghatti Developers offering 528 studios and 1-bedroom apartments from AED 649,999, on a 20/50/30 payment plan with April 2026 handover.
binghatti-apex.long_description: Binghatti Apex is a contemporary 33-storey tower in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti Developers, built on a ground-plus-five-podium layout. It offers a premium collection of 528 studios and 1-bedroom apartments sized 344 to 915 sq. ft., complemented by mixed-use retail and commercial spaces. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and 24/7 security. Priced from AED 649,999 with a 70/30 payment plan (20% down payment, 50% during construction) and handover in April 2026.

binghatti-aurora.title: Binghatti Aurora
binghatti-aurora.description: Binghatti Aurora in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti offers 275 residences — 92 studios, 163 one-bed and 20 two-bed apartments — from AED 666,666.
binghatti-aurora.long_description: Binghatti Aurora captures a spirited sense of wonder — a beacon emerging within night's serenity — in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle. Developed by Binghatti, an emblem of excellence within the global real estate sector, the tower delivers 275 residential units: 92 studios, 163 one-bedroom apartments and 20 two-bedroom apartments, with typical unit areas around 380 sq. ft. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 666,666.

binghatti-dusk.title: Binghatti Dusk
binghatti-dusk.description: Binghatti Dusk in Jumeirah Village Circle offers 105 residences — 52 studios and 53 one-bedroom apartments — plus 2 ground-floor retail shops, starting from AED 699,999.
binghatti-dusk.long_description: Evoking a sense of introspection, Binghatti Dusk is inspired by the liminal state where the fading glow of the sun merges with shadows at night. Located in Jumeirah Village Circle by the renowned Emirati property brand Binghatti, this mixed-use development delivers 105 residential units — 52 studios and 53 one-bedroom apartments from 407 sq. ft. — alongside 2 ground-floor retail shops. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and 24/7 security. Priced from AED 699,999.

bugatti-residences.title: Bugatti Residences
bugatti-residences.description: Bugatti Residences in Business Bay is an ultra-luxury 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment of 5,903 sq. ft. from AED 20,381,172, inspired by Bugatti's supercar heritage with a 70/30 payment plan and Q4 2026 handover.
bugatti-residences.long_description: Bugatti Residences in Business Bay draws directly from Bugatti's supercar heritage, delivering a 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom sky home of 5,903 sq. ft. Every detail celebrates high-end finishes, exquisite craftsmanship and the latest state-of-the-art smart home system, with cutting-edge technology integrated throughout. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and on-site café and restaurants. Priced from AED 20,381,172 with a 70/30 payment plan (70% on handover, 30% during construction) and Q4 2026 handover.

binghatti-royale-2.title: Binghatti Royale 2
binghatti-royale-2.description: Binghatti Royale 2 in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti offers 354 residences — 340 one-bed and 10 two-bed apartments — with 16 ground-floor retail shops, starting from AED 3,629,999.
binghatti-royale-2.long_description: Binghatti Royale 2 by Binghatti is a mixed-use residential and retail development in Jumeirah Village Circle, where every aspect of living is curated to exude elegance and refinement, blending modern and harmonious design concepts. The tower delivers 354 residential units — 340 one-bedroom and 10 two-bedroom apartments — alongside 16 ground-floor retail shops, with a built-up footprint of 5,776 sq. ft. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, private balconies and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 3,629,999.

binghatti-ghost.title: Binghatti Ghost
binghatti-ghost.description: Binghatti Ghost in Al Jaddaf by Binghatti offers 770 units — 438 studios, 232 one-bed and 40 two-bed apartments — starting from AED 888,888.
binghatti-ghost.long_description: Binghatti Ghost is a residential development by Binghatti — an emblem of excellence within the global real estate sector — located in the heart of Al Jaddaf, Dubai. The project delivers 770 apartments across 438 studios, 232 one-bedroom and 40 two-bedroom units, with individual homes around 650 sq. ft. and a total built-up area of 6,507 sq. ft. Designed as a unique blend of comfort, style and accessibility, it combines sophistication with urban convenience. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 888,888.

trillionaire-residences.title: Trillionaire Residences
trillionaire-residences.description: Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti is an ultra-luxury waterfront address of 59 exclusive one-bedroom residences in Dubai, priced from AED 300 million.
trillionaire-residences.long_description: Few properties offer the privilege of waterfront living together with the heights of luxury. Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti brings these elements together in Dubai to create a truly unique living experience. This ultra-exclusive tower delivers 59 one-bedroom residences on a plot of 4,705 sq. m. (approximately 50,648 sq. ft.), combining refined residential space with curated retail. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gymnasium, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and private balconies overlooking the water. Priced from AED 300,000,000.

albero.title: Albero
albero.description: Albero at Dubai Creek Harbour offers 421 one and two-bedroom waterfront residences from AED 1,810,000, blending luxury with lush landscapes, creek views and vibrant retail.
albero.long_description: Albero offers stunning views of lush landscapes, sparkling creeks and cityscapes at Dubai Creek Harbour, blending luxury with nature in a waterfront community. The development delivers 211 one-bedroom apartments of 754 sq. ft. from AED 1,810,000 and 210 two-bedroom apartments of 1,177 sq. ft. from AED 2,710,000. Stroll the vibrant waterfront, relax in peaceful parks and explore dynamic retail spaces — whether by the canal or golf course, Albero balances adventure and calmness. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area, private balconies, on-site nursery, health care centre and BBQ zones.

binghatti-skyrise.title: Binghatti Skyrise
binghatti-skyrise.description: Binghatti Skyrise in Business Bay by Binghatti Developers offers 762 studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments plus retail from AED 1,100,000, with handover in 2026.
binghatti-skyrise.long_description: Binghatti Skyrise is a refined residential and retail development by Binghatti Developers in Business Bay, offering luxurious sky living in the heart of Dubai's eminent commercial metropolitan hub. The tower delivers 762 apartments across studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom configurations from 465 sq. ft., served by a dedicated parking floor and ground-floor retail. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 1,100,000 with handover scheduled for 2026.

skyvue-stellar-1-b-a.title: Skyvue Stellar 1B-A
skyvue-stellar-1-b-a.location: Sobha Hartland II, Ras Al Khor, Dubai, UAE
skyvue-stellar-1-b-a.description: Skyvue Stellar 1B-A by Sobha is the tallest tower in the Skyvue collection at Sobha Hartland II, offering 31-floor apartments with panoramic Downtown Dubai and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary views, starting AED 1,678,677.
skyvue-stellar-1-b-a.long_description: Skyvue Stellar 1B-A stands as the tallest tower in Sobha's Skyvue collection at Sobha Hartland II, rising 31 floors with luxury apartments offering unobstructed views of Downtown Dubai and the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary. Each residence spans about 632 sq. ft. total — with 518–525 sq. ft. of suite area and a generous 107 sq. ft. balcony — carefully designed for elevated living. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ zones. Priced from AED 1,678,677.

binghatti-royale.title: Binghatti Royale
binghatti-royale.description: Binghatti Royale in Jumeirah Village Circle by Binghatti offers 354 residences — 340 one-bed and 10 two-bed apartments — with 16 ground-floor retail shops, starting from AED 3,629,999.
binghatti-royale.long_description: Binghatti Royale epitomizes prestige and sophistication. Located in Jumeirah Village Circle, the tower delivers 354 residential units comprising 340 one-bedroom and 10 two-bedroom apartments alongside 16 ground-floor retail shops. Inspired by both modern and harmonious design concepts, Binghatti Royale achieves a seamless fusion of exclusivity and functionality, with intricate details, generous layouts up to 5,776 sq. ft. and a lifestyle synonymous with regality. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, private balconies, health care centre, café and restaurants, basketball and tennis courts and 24/7 security. Priced from AED 3,629,999.

adh-zabeel.title: ADH Zabeel
adh-zabeel.location: Al Jaddaf & DHCC, Downtown Dubai, UAE
adh-zabeel.description: ADH Zabeel by Emaar, next to Souq Al Bahar in Downtown Dubai, offers 1–3 bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses across two towers of 50 and 52 floors, starting from AED 1,800,888.
adh-zabeel.long_description: ADH Zabeel by Emaar is an ultra-luxury Downtown Dubai address adjacent to Souq Al Bahar, spanning the Al Jaddaf and DHCC districts. The development comprises Tower 1 (198.85 m, 50 floors) and Tower 3 (205.35 m, 52 floors), delivering 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive penthouses. Each residence speaks to city dwellers who crave a contemporary yet comfortable lifestyle, with elegance in the details and sweeping views of the Downtown skyline. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities. Priced from AED 1,800,888.

skyvue-stellar.title: Skyvue Stellar
skyvue-stellar.description: Skyvue Stellar is a 63-storey Ras Al Khor tower offering apartments from AED 2,420,367 with unmatched views of Downtown Dubai and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary.
skyvue-stellar.long_description: Skyvue Stellar rises 63 floors above Ras Al Khor, offering apartments with unmatched views of Dubai's iconic skyline, Downtown Dubai and the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary. Each residence spans around 899–905 sq. ft. — with suite areas of 837–842 sq. ft. and a 62 sq. ft. balcony — carefully designed for comfort and elevated lifestyle. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and generous private balconies. Priced from AED 2,420,367.

perla-prime.title: Perla Prime
perla-prime.location: Yas West, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE
perla-prime.description: Perla Prime at Yas West by Reportage Properties is a waterfront community of 190 duplex apartments and townhouses from AED 1,500,002, with 10% down payment and 1% monthly plan, handover Q3 2025.
perla-prime.long_description: Reportage Properties Perla Prime at Yas West in Abu Dhabi features 2, 3 and 5-bedroom duplex apartments and 4-bedroom townhouses, delivering 190 waterfront homes with a remarkable contemporary façade and panoramic canal views. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, residents enjoy an unrivalled resort-styled lifestyle surrounded by parks and community areas, with a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and on-site café and restaurants. Unit sizes range from 1,007 to 2,487 sq. ft. Priced from AED 1,500,002 with a 10% down payment and 1% monthly plan, handover Q3 2025.

royal-park.title: Royal Park
royal-park.description: Royal Park in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi is a six-cluster regal retreat of 522 one-bed, 170 two-bed and 152 four-bed apartments, penthouses and townhouses, starting from AED 804,195.
royal-park.long_description: Royal Park is a residential community nestled next to Masdar Central Park in Abu Dhabi, designed as a regal retreat that combines classic beauty with modern design across six clusters. The development offers 522 one-bedroom apartments (485–636 sq. ft. from AED 804,195), 170 two-bedroom apartments (840–1,316 sq. ft. from AED 1,290,757) and 65 four-bedroom apartments (1,381–2,202 sq. ft. from AED 1,852,726), alongside 42 four-bedroom penthouses and 45 four-bedroom G+2 townhouses. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and an on-site health care centre.

selina-bay.title: Selina Bay
selina-bay.description: Selina Bay on Yas Island by Reportage Properties offers studios to 4-bedroom homes, including penthouses and townhouses, from AED 1,080,699 with a 40% down payment and 1% monthly plan, handover 2028.
selina-bay.long_description: Selina Bay is a mixed-use waterfront community by Reportage Properties on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. The development includes studios (447–864 sq. ft. from AED 1,080,699), 1-bedroom apartments (863–1,443 sq. ft. from AED 1,717,925), 2-bedroom units (1,233–3,047 sq. ft. from AED 2,024,529), 3-bedroom homes (1,587–3,667 sq. ft. from AED 2,484,655) and 4-bedroom townhouses (2,799–3,222 sq. ft. from AED 4,248,399). Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities, basketball and tennis courts. Flexible payment terms of 40% down payment with 1% monthly installments and handover scheduled for 2028.

verdana-phase-6.title: Verdana Phase 6
verdana-phase-6.description: Verdana Phase 6 at Dubai Investment Park by Reportage Properties offers studios to 4-bedroom apartments and 2–4 bedroom townhouses from AED 490,000, on a 30/70 plan with Q4 2028 handover.
verdana-phase-6.long_description: Verdana Phase 6 at DIP offers a flawless fusion of modern living, delivering studios (from 492 sq. ft.), 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments and 2–4 bedroom townhouses, with sizes ranging from 366 to 2,748 sq. ft. Units feature contemporary finishes, built-in wardrobes, modern kitchen cabinets and fully-tiled bathrooms designed to optimise comfort and space. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, walking track, kids play area and BBQ facilities within a landscaped community setting. Priced from AED 490,000 with a 30/70 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2028.

verdana-phase-5.title: Verdana Phase 5
verdana-phase-5.description: Verdana Phase 5 at Dubai Investment Park by Reportage Properties offers 392 apartments (studio–4BR) and 271 townhouses (2–4BR) from AED 484,000, with a fast-track full-payment-in-3-months plan.
verdana-phase-5.long_description: Verdana Phase 5 at Dubai Investment Park (DIP) by Reportage Properties is poised to offer the next residential experience, with studios to four-bedroom apartments and two to four-bedroom townhouses. This phase brings 271 townhouses and 392 flats, precisely constructed to appeal to a variety of lifestyles and preferences with an exquisite lifestyle. Building on the reputation of its earlier phases as a modern high-end neighborhood, Verdana emphasizes a lavish lifestyle while remaining accessible to Dubai's key attractions. Residents enjoy two swimming pools, 24/7 security, gym and walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities, café and restaurants and basketball and tennis courts. Starting from AED 484,000 with a full-payment-in-3-months plan and Q4 2028 handover.

renad-tower.title: Renad Tower
renad-tower.location: Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE
renad-tower.description: Renad Tower is a 37-storey furnished apartment development on Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, offering 265 residences across 1, 2 and 3-bedroom layouts from AED 840,000.
renad-tower.long_description: The tower's name draws its inspiration from a captivating desert flower known for its extraordinary beauty, and Renad Tower is being constructed with a commitment to exude the same exceptional allure. Rising 37 floors above Al Reem Island on Abu Dhabi's northeast coast, the tower offers 265 fully-furnished residences: 190 one-bedroom, 67 two-bedroom and 8 three-bedroom units, served by two basement parking levels. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones, on-site café and restaurants, basketball and tennis courts and a dedicated health care centre. Al Reem Island is a stunning manmade gem of the UAE with innovative architecture, luxurious recreation and contemporary design, making it an unparalleled hub of modern living. Starting from AED 840,000.

verdana-phase-7.title: Verdana Phase 7
verdana-phase-7.description: Verdana Phase 7 at Dubai Investment Park by Reportage Properties offers 392 apartments and 293 townhouses from studios to 4-bedroom layouts, starting AED 530,000 on a 30/70 payment plan, handover Q4 2028.
verdana-phase-7.long_description: Verdana Phase 7 at Dubai Investment Park (DIP) by Reportage Properties is the latest chapter of the Verdana community, delivering 392 apartments (studio to 4-bedroom) and 293 townhouses (2 to 4-bedroom) with sizes ranging from 363 to 2,634 sq. ft. Designed for modern family living, the community offers a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and a health care centre. Priced from AED 530,000 with a flexible 30/70 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2028.

blvd-heights.title: BLVD Heights
blvd-heights.description: BLVD Heights by Emaar Properties is a premium residential twin-tower in Downtown Dubai offering 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments from AED 2,092,000, with a 20% down payment and 20/80 payment plan.
blvd-heights.long_description: BLVD Heights is a landmark Downtown Dubai address by the globally-recognised Emaar Properties, whose developments encapsulate the essence of what Dubai has come to symbolise to the world. Positioned along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, the twin-tower community offers 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments from 856 sq. ft., with iconic views of Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Fountain. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and on-site café and restaurants. Priced from AED 2,092,000 with 20% down payment and 20/80 payment plan. Handover August 2023.

alba-tower.title: Alba Tower
alba-tower.description: Alba Tower in Al Satwa offers 1 and 2-bedroom luxury residences from AED 1,009,617 with a 20/41/39 payment plan and handover in Q4 2027, combining elegant design with prime central Dubai convenience.
alba-tower.long_description: Alba Tower, strategically positioned in the busy Al Satwa sector in the heart of Dubai, delivers the city's elegance to your doorstep. This luxury residential mid-rise offers 1 and 2-bedroom apartments ranging from 681 to 2,161 sq. ft., with two-bedroom units starting from AED 1,455,357. Alba Tower redefines urban living by combining thoughtful design and convenience with a haven of comfort, sophistication and quiet amidst the hustle and bustle of the metropolis. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ, private balconies, café and restaurants, health care centre, basketball and tennis courts, and 24/7 security. Priced from AED 1,009,617 with a 20% down payment, 41% during construction and 39% on handover in Q4 2027.

the-lana-residences.title: The Lana Residences – Dorchester Collection
the-lana-residences.description: The Lana Residences by Omniyat, in association with the Dorchester Collection, is an ultra-luxury Business Bay address of just 9 three-bedroom residences and 8 four-bedroom duplexes with 8 double-height rooms and legendary hospitality.
the-lana-residences.long_description: The Lana Residences is an ultra-luxury development by Omniyat in Business Bay, Dubai, operated in association with the world-renowned Dorchester Collection. This intimate address is limited to 9 three-bedroom residences and 8 four-bedroom duplexes, several featuring 8 double-height rooms, with generous layouts around 3,900 sq. ft. The project is defined by exceptional hospitality and seeking after experiences of good living, charm, elegance and unparalleled service, complemented by a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids area and BBQ zones.

dubai-azizi-venice.title: Dubai Azizi Venice
dubai-azizi-venice.location: Dubai South, near Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai, UAE
dubai-azizi-venice.description: Azizi Venice is a 136-hectare water-inspired community in Dubai South by Azizi Developments, featuring 30,000+ residences, a swimmable crystal lagoon and vibrant retail boulevard, starting from AED 590,000.
dubai-azizi-venice.long_description: Across the stunning Arabian sands of Dubai South lies Dubai's newest water-inspired legacy – Azizi Venice. Spanning over 136 hectares and located in close proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport along Emirates Road, this awe-inspiring destination features a luxurious gated villa community alongside a mixed-use residential development, with more than 10,000 units under construction and over 31,000 planned in total. Every home is connected by a swimmable crystal lagoon, a vibrant retail boulevard, cafés, restaurants, nurseries, sports courts, gyms, walking tracks and a dedicated health care centre, all with 24/7 security. Starting from AED 590,000, with handover scheduled for Q4 2025.

mercedes-benz-places.title: Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti
mercedes-benz-places.description: Mercedes-Benz Places by Binghatti is a 51-storey icon in Downtown Dubai, defined by Sensual Purity design, precision engineering and a 20% down payment 70/30 payment plan.
mercedes-benz-places.long_description: Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti City is a landmark residential tower embodying the spirit of an icon that is quintessentially brilliant. Rising 51 residential floors with 4.2m ceiling heights and 150 exclusive units, its design philosophy of Sensual Purity merges spectacular proportions with beauty and efficiency. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and a health care centre. Priced from AED 808,000, with 20% down payment and a 70/30 payment plan. Handover Q4 2026.

taormina-village-by-reportage-properties.title: Taormina Village By Reportage Properties
taormina-village-by-reportage-properties.description: Taormina Village by Reportage Properties is an 838-unit gated community in Wadi Al Safa, Dubai, offering 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses and luxury villas with resort-style amenities.
taormina-village-by-reportage-properties.long_description: Taormina Village is a master-planned community by Reportage Properties located in Wadi Al Safa, Dubai. Spread across 838 units, the development includes 392 three-bedroom townhouses (G+2), 30 three-bedroom luxury villas, 334 four-bedroom townhouses and 46 four-bedroom luxury villas, averaging around 1,882 sq. ft. Residents enjoy a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ facilities and generous private balconies, all within a landscaped community setting. Starting from AED 2,860,000.

damac-suncity.title: Damac Suncity
damac-suncity.description: Luxurious 4 & 5-bedroom townhouses at DAMAC Suncity in Cherrywoods, Dubailand. Spacious homes from 2,319 to 3,231 sq. ft., featuring walk-in closets, maid's room, private terrace and 2-3 floor layouts, with a flexible 75/25 payment plan.
damac-suncity.long_description: DAMAC Suncity is an exclusive collection of 749 townhouses located in Cherrywoods, Dubailand. The spacious homes, from 2,319 to 3,231 sq. ft., have been designed to reflect a luxurious living experience. Each residence features walk-in closets, a maid's room, private terrace and 2-3 floor layouts. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including a swimming pool, gym, walking track, basketball and tennis courts, kids play area and BBQ zones. Starting from AED 2,720,000 with a 75/25 payment plan.

sobha-solis.title: Sobha Solis
sobha-solis.location: Street D6, Jumeirah Village, District 1, Dubai, UAE
sobha-solis.description: Sobha Solis offers 1, 1.5, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Village, District 1, showcasing architectural perfection and the latest living standards, just 2 minutes from DMCC Metro Station.
sobha-solis.long_description: Sobha Solis is a landmark residential development by Sobha Group located on Street D6 in Jumeirah Village, District 1, Dubai. The project features a curated selection of 1, 1.5, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, ranging from 546.38 sq. ft. up to 1,888.85 sq. ft. Designed with architectural perfection and the latest living standards in mind, residents enjoy premium amenities including a swimming pool, gym, walking track, kids play area, BBQ zones and on-site café and restaurants. Positioned just 2 minutes from DMCC Metro Station, it offers seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai. Starting from AED 1,010,000.

the-acres.title: The Acres
the-acres.description: The Acres offers premium 3, 4 and 5-bedroom villas and residential plots in Dubai Marina by Provident Estate, with spacious layouts from 3,915 to 9,483 sq. ft. and a curated collection of lifestyle amenities.
the-acres.long_description: The Acres is an exclusive residential development by Provident Estate in Dubai Marina, offering 3-bedroom villas of 3,915 sq. ft., 4-bedroom homes of 4,874 sq. ft. and 5-bedroom plots up to 9,483 sq. ft., with a built-up area of around 7,207 sq. ft. Designed for those who value space, privacy and refined living, residents enjoy world-class amenities including a swimming pool, gym, walking track, basketball and tennis courts, kids play area and BBQ zones. Starting from AED 1,350,000.

diamondz-by-danube.title: Diamondz by Danube
diamondz-by-danube.description: Diamondz by Danube — a 65-storey luxury JLT tower with 1,200 units, from studios with private pools up to 4 BR pool residences. Priced AED 1.1M-4.8M.
diamondz-by-danube.long_description: Diamondz by Danube, nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Lake Towers, invites you to experience the epitome of luxury living. Rising majestically over 65 storeys with 1,200 units, Diamondz offers a unique perspective on opulent living where every detail is meticulously crafted. Layouts run from Studio + Pool (AED 1.3M) through 1 BR (AED 1.75M), 2 BR + Pool (AED 2.5M), 3 BR + Pool (AED 3.65M) up to 4 BR + Pool (AED 4.816M), each paired with a full lifestyle amenity deck of Gym, Swimming Pool, Kids Area, Café & Restaurants, Basketball & Tennis Court, Nursery, Health Care Centre and 24/7 Security.

nobles-business-bay.title: Nobles, Business Bay
nobles-business-bay.description: Nobles, Business Bay — a 45-storey luxury tower by Tiger Properties with 1, 2 & 3 BR furnished apartments and Business Bay city views. From AED 190,000 with 50% down.
nobles-business-bay.long_description: Nobles is a 45-storey luxurious residential tower by Tiger Properties in Business Bay, delivering 549 furnished 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments across beautifully designed interiors. The tower stands tall with great elevations that let residents appreciate wonderful Dubai city views, paired with a full amenity deck of Gym, Kids Area, Walking Track, Basketball & Tennis Court, Cafés and Restaurants and 24/7 Security. Starting from AED 190,000 on a 50% down payment plan — a substantial Business Bay entry for both end-users and investors.

seslia-tower-jvt.title: Seslia Tower, JVT
seslia-tower-jvt.description: Seslia Tower, JVT — an investment-focused industrial-style tower with 12 studios across 36 furnished floors. From AED 654,000 with 20% down. Handover Dec 2025.
seslia-tower-jvt.long_description: Seslia Tower is an investment-focused residential tower in Jumeirah Village Triangle featuring an industrial-style architectural language, with functional lines and raw-material aesthetics running through the public areas. The tower comprises 36 furnished apartment floors including 12 studios, supported by 4 parking floors, and is engineered to help investors maximise their return through modern layouts and a full amenity deck. Handover is scheduled for December 2025 on a 20% down payment plan.

cloud-jvt.title: Cloud, JVT
cloud-jvt.description: Cloud, JVT — a 27-floor residential tower with 447 furnished apartments, delivering state-of-the-art facilities in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle. From AED 450,000.
cloud-jvt.long_description: Cloud Towers in JVT will be the perfect place for your next home because we always think about your comfort and value your needs. The 27-storey tower delivers 447 residential apartments including 6 studios above 5 parking floors, with a compact 378.57 sqft entry footprint and a full amenity deck — Swimming Pool, Gym, Kids Area, BBQ, Walking Track and on-site Health Care Centre. A strong Jumeirah Village Triangle entry point for both end-users and yield-focused investors.

seahaven-tower-b.title: SeaHaven Tower B
seahaven-tower-b.description: SeaHaven Tower B — a Sobha tower rising from Dubai Harbour with Palm Jumeirah and Ain Dubai views. Apartments and penthouses from AED 3,140,000 on a 60/40 plan with 20% down.
seahaven-tower-b.long_description: SeaHaven Tower B is a new Sobha tower rising from the heart of Dubai Harbour, delivering apartments and penthouses with direct views of Palm Jumeirah and Ain Dubai. Residents step into a fully-serviced waterfront destination with adjacent shopping, dining and entertainment venues, framed by a leisure amenity deck of Swimming Pool, Gym, Kids Area, BBQ and Walking Track. Handover is scheduled for December 2026 on a 20% down / 60-40 payment plan — a marquee entry point on Dubai's waterfront.

sobha-firdous.title: Sobha Firdous
sobha-firdous.location: Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, UAE
sobha-firdous.description: Sobha Firdous — a high-end island resort community on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, with studios, apartments and 196 villas set within a nature reserve of islands, lagoons and beaches. From AED 876,258.
sobha-firdous.long_description: Sobha Firdous is a high-end holiday destination on Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain, sitting within an untouched nature reserve of interconnected islands, lagoons and beaches. The masterplan combines 48 furnished residential floors — 244 flats, including 26 studios — with 196 villas set alongside a golf course, marina and 6 km of beach access. Residents get 27% green space and water bodies across the community, two luxury resorts, retail and F&B outlets, and a full leisure amenity deck. Studios start at AED 876,258; villas from AED 1,050,000.

volga-tower-jvt.title: Volga Tower, JVT
volga-tower-jvt.description: Volga Tower, JVT — outstanding architecture and magnificent natural scenes with 390 furnished apartments over 40 floors. Starting from AED 1,500,000 with sizes from 776.4 sqft.
volga-tower-jvt.long_description: Volga Tower brings a fresh residential silhouette to Jumeirah Village Triangle — a landmark known for its outstanding architecture and magnificent natural scenes. The 40-floor tower delivers 390 furnished apartments comprising 124 one-bedroom units and 193 two-bedroom units, all sitting above 4 parking floors. Residents enjoy a landscaped podium with a Kids Area, BBQ zones, gym, walking track, swimming pool, and basketball & tennis courts — a rare amenity mix at this price point in JVT. Kangar coordinates the full off-plan purchase: unit shortlist, payment plan, mortgage pre-approval for non-residents and DLD registration.

lilium-tower-jvt.title: Lilium Tower, JVT
lilium-tower-jvt.description: Lilium Tower, JVT — a 28-storey residential landmark known for outstanding architecture and magnificent natural panoramas. From AED 560,000 with 10% down on a 2-year P.H.O. plan.
lilium-tower-jvt.long_description: Lilium Tower is a residential tower in Jumeirah Village Triangle known for its outstanding architecture and magnificent natural panoramas, delivering a bustling ambiance amidst peaceful surroundings. The tower comprises 263 apartments across 28 residential floors, from a compact 380.83 sqft footprint, supported by a full leisure and lifestyle amenity deck. Handover is scheduled for March 2026 on a 10% down, 2-year post-handover payment plan — a strong entry point for both end-users and JVT-focused investors.

expo-valley-by-expo-city-dubai.title: Expo Valley by Expo City Dubai
expo-valley-by-expo-city-dubai.description: Expo Valley by Expo City Dubai — 3-5 BR villas, duets and townhouses set among nature reserves, lakes and wadis. From AED 954,400 on a 50/50 plan with 10% down.
expo-valley-by-expo-city-dubai.long_description: Expo Valley by Expo City Dubai is a premium development offering a choice of 3-5 bedroom villas, duets and townhouses overlooking nature reserves, lakes and wadis engineered to create a unique on-site microclimate. Delivered by the Expo Dubai Group on the legacy Expo City masterplan, the community pairs low-density family living with a full amenity deck — Health Care Centre, Café & Restaurants, Walking Track, Swimming Pool and 24/7 security. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2025 on a 10% down / 50-50 payment plan.

tiger-seslia-tower.title: Tiger / Seslia Tower
tiger-seslia-tower.description: Tiger / Seslia Tower — a 36-floor JVT development with industrial-style architecture, raw material finishes and a full leisure deck. Starting from AED 974,450 with sizes from 1,427.01 sqft.
tiger-seslia-tower.long_description: Tiger / Seslia Tower rises 36 furnished floors above 4 parking levels and a basement in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle, delivering 360 residential flats designed for investors seeking to maximise return. The tower's industrial-style design uses raw materials and bold contrasts across public areas, paired with a full amenity deck — café and restaurants, gymnasium, walking track, swimming pool, health care centre and 24/7 security — for a self-contained community experience.

saadiyat-lagoons-villas-by-aldar.title: Saadiyat Lagoons Villas by Aldar
saadiyat-lagoons-villas-by-aldar.description: Saadiyat Lagoons Villas by Aldar — 207 ultra-luxury 4-6 BR villas on Saadiyat Island with prep kitchens, maid/driver quarters, private pools and elevators. From AED 1,742,475 with 10% down.
saadiyat-lagoons-villas-by-aldar.long_description: Saadiyat Lagoons Villas by Aldar is an ultra-luxury villa community of 207 exclusive residences on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi. Each 4-6 bedroom villa is configured for full-service living with a prep kitchen, maid and driver quarters, private swimming pool and in-home elevator, framed by a lifestyle amenity deck of Health Care Centre, Basketball & Tennis Court, Café & Restaurants and Walking Track. Residents live surrounded by the iconic attractions of Saadiyat Island — including the Louvre Abu Dhabi and other cultural venues — with handover scheduled for 2026 on a 10% down payment plan.

tiger-nobles-tower.title: Tiger / Nobles Tower
tiger-nobles-tower.description: Tiger / Nobles Tower — a 45-storey Business Bay landmark elegantly projecting refinement, with great elevations for wonderful city views. Starting from AED 1,983,654 with sizes from 1,492.95 sqft.
tiger-nobles-tower.long_description: Society defines the word "Noble" as someone who maintains high morals and ideals, or as a group of people of royal bloodline. True to its name, Tiger / Nobles Tower elegantly projects refinement through the design of the building structure. The tower stands tall with great elevations that let you appreciate wonderful city views across Business Bay. Rising 45 residential floors above 5 parking floors, the development delivers 549 residential flats — a substantial address for owner-occupiers and investors seeking a Business Bay foothold.

the-valley.title: Avena at The Valley Phase 2
the-valley.description: Avena at The Valley Phase 2 — 3 & 4 bedroom townhomes in a nature-focused Dubai community with a Golden Beach, Sports Village and Town Centre. Starting from AED 435,700.
the-valley.long_description: Avena at The Valley Phase 2 is a residential neighbourhood strategically positioned along the Dubai–Al Ain corridor between Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The development offers 3 and 4 bedroom townhomes set within a green, nature-focused masterplan that anchors daily life around a 47,000 sqm Golden Beach, a 13,000 sqm Kids Dale, a 25,000 sqm Sports Village and a 32,000 sqm Town Centre. Residents get a balanced lifestyle with on-site educational and medical facilities, retail and entertainment — a family-first alternative to central Dubai living.

tiger-neva-residences.title: Tiger / Neva Residences
tiger-neva-residences.description: Tiger / Neva Residences — a 17-storey mixed-use development in JVC with furnished studios, 1 & 2 BR apartments, offices and retail. From AED 520,000 with 20% down payment.
tiger-neva-residences.long_description: Tiger / Neva Residences is a 17-storey residential development by Tiger Group offering a curated collection of studios, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle. The tower combines furnished apartment floors with ground-level retail and office space, all supported by 4 dedicated parking floors. With handover scheduled for December 2025, a 20% down payment and a flexible payment plan, Neva is positioned for both end-users seeking a turnkey Dubai home and investors targeting JVC yields.

tiger-elbrus-tower.title: Tiger / Elbrus Tower
tiger-elbrus-tower.description: Tiger / Elbrus Tower — a 29-storey JVT landmark with modern designs, fascinating facilities and Arabian vibes. Starting from AED 598,791 with sizes from 811.18 sqft.
tiger-elbrus-tower.long_description: Tiger / Elbrus Tower rises 29 storeys over Jumeirah Village Triangle, delivering modern design, luxury amenities and serene Arabian-inspired living. The tower houses 268 residential units — 52 studios, 162 one-bedroom apartments and 54 two-bedroom apartments — each engineered for comfort with stunning views over the surrounding landscape. Flexible payment plans and a full amenity deck make it a strong entry point for both end-users and investors seeking JVT rental yields.

tiger-cloud-tower.title: Tiger / Cloud Tower
tiger-cloud-tower.description: Tiger / Cloud Tower in JVT — the perfect place for your next home, delivering state-of-the-art facilities and comfort-first design. Starting from AED 1,307,103 with sizes from 949.48 sqft.
tiger-cloud-tower.long_description: Cloud Towers in JVT will be the perfect place for your next home because we always think about your comfort and value your needs. Rising across 29 residential floors above 2 basement levels and 4 podium parking floors, the development delivers state-of-the-art facilities in the heart of Jumeirah Village District 2, combining a landscaped podium, resort-style leisure amenities and family-focused active zones in one integrated address.

tiger-altai-tower.title: Tiger / Altai Tower
tiger-altai-tower.location: Street D6, Jumeirah Village, District 1, Dubai, UAE
tiger-altai-tower.description: Tiger / Altai Tower offers high-end apartments with fantastic views in Jumeirah Village, Dubai. Starting from AED 876,258 with sizes from 618.17 sqft.
tiger-altai-tower.long_description: Tiger / Altai Tower is a superior residential building designed to admire Dubai's skyline. The tower features 244 residential units across 26 furnished floors, including 48 studio apartments, 146 one-bedroom apartments and 50 two-bedroom apartments, supported by 5 parking floors. The architectural design blends seamlessly with the surrounding Jumeirah Village community while delivering high-end living with fantastic panoramic views.
